how to fill available doctor time slot

To fill an available doctor time slot for consultation billing, follow these steps: 1. Select a Doctor. 2. Check Available Time Slots. 3. Assess Schedule Assignment. 4. Choose a Time Slot. 5. Confirm Appointment. 6. Final Review. 7. Complete the Booking. 8. Receive Confirmation.
